column2: (Horoscopy of women, from planets in the seventh and other houses:) A sharp-tongued woman, one married a second time, one with good qualities, learned and famous, born in a household of a master.

With Mercury's influence she is equal; with a neuter planet, a good, virtuous, but fickle wife; in a dual sign she is wanton; rich in qualities but a lowly craftswoman; talkative, unchaste; in Leo, passionate and unapproachable...
With Jupiter, rich in qualities, with little passion, knowing qualities, wise and chaste; as a maidservant she is lowly in passion; with Saturn, she is virtuous but wicked and childless.
The result follows the strength of the ascendant, the Moon and the thirds (drekkana); by mutual aspect, the Sun and Venus in Venus's sign, or in the water-pot navamsa:
women go in sexual union with women, inflamed with the fire of desire; with an empty seventh a cowardly husband, and in strength, an impotent one, not an equal.
With Mercury and the Sun in a movable sign, he is always devoted to foreign lands; with the Sun in the proud sign, a wife, a child and a widow are made so; with Mars...
With Saturn aspected by malefics in the seventh, a girl grows old even as a maiden; with malefics in the fire signs, widowhood; mixed with the sign of a remarried woman, she would be so.
With a cruel weak planet in the seventh, she is cast off by her husband and not equal; with Venus and Mars in mutual divisions, the woman is attached to another.
When the Moon is in the seventh, she follows her husband; with Saturn or Mars's sign rising, together with Moon and Venus, she is a harlot.
With a bad aspect together with her mother, and with a Mars-division in the seventh, and with weak aspect, she is of a diseased birth; with the division of a good planet, she is dear to her husband.
With Saturn's sign or division in the seventh, the husband is old or a fool; with Mars, fond of women and angry; with Mercury, learned and skilful.
With Jupiter, self-controlled and virtuous; with the Moon, lustful and gentle; with Venus, fortunate and loving; with Saturn, one who does low work.
With Venus and the Moon in the ascendant, she is happy but jealous; with Mercury and Jupiter, skilled in the arts, happy and virtuous.
With a cruel planet in the eighth, and the lord of the eighth in the eighth division, for one whose age is even — widowhood and death for her; or for herself with good aspects in the right places.
Few children if the Moon is in the eighth; in Virgo, Scorpio and Leo, and with Saturn of middling strength, the Moon, Venus and Mercury lacking strength,
and the others strong, with an odd sign rising, she would be ill-favoured. With Jupiter, Mars, Venus and Mercury strong, and the ascendant in an even sign,
the woman is famed, learned in many sciences, a speaker of Brahman. With a malefic in the seventh and a planet in the ninth, the woman goes forth as an ascetic.
In marriage, choosing, and questions, all this should be considered. For the place of death, those who look...
Death for men is suitable by... with strong planets many (causes): fire, wounds, fever, anal disease,
thirst and hunger from those in the eighth, by Sun and the rest; the Sun and Mars cause death in other people's lands and roads.
With the two in the place of kin, of a man, by a mountain, fire and... (death by various causes); by Saturn and Mars in the fourth or eighth house, the Sun and Mars, death.
For women, death by cold and heat, from a family member, with malefic aspects; by water if the Sun is in a certain season at sunrise.
With the Moon in the eighth house in Mars's sign, death by weapon or fire; with the Moon in Capricorn, Cancer or Saturn's sign, from dropsy.
For women, the Moon causing blood-swelling; Saturn causing death by wind or fire; from a son in the ninth... with the two malefics aspected.
By noose, chains and fetters, in aspect with the eighth, by binding; for women with a malefic Moon in the seventh, Venus in Aries, Sun in the ascendant,
death in a house made for a woman; then Mars and Sun in the fourth, Saturn in the ascendant, trines, the waning Moon and good planets, once.
With the Sun in the fourth, Mars in the tenth, the waning Moon aspected, by fire... eighth, tenth, ascendant, water, with the waning Moon, Mars, Saturn and Sun joined,
by a club, then by those same planets in the ascendant and fifth, by burning smoke, bad food; death comes.
With the planets in the fourth, eighth and tenth, Mars, Sun and Saturn, by weapon, fire, kings; by Saturn from his door; the wounds follow.
With the Sun in his own house, Mars in the fourth: death by falling from a vehicle; with Mars in the seventh, by a machine; joined with the waning Moon, death.
With Mars, Saturn and the Moon in Libra, Aries and Capricorn; the waning Moon, Sun and Mars in the tenth and fourth: death by Sunday's...
With a weak, Mars-aspected waning Moon, Saturn in the eighth: death by hidden disease, worms, weapon, fire or wood — Angiras (says).
With the Sun and Saturn in the seventh, death; with Saturn and the waning Moon joined, on earth; by the ascendant, Sun, Mars, Moon.
Death by a fall from a mountain peak or by a fierce blow; the lord of the eighth or an aspect to the eighth with the trine from the twenty-second decan.
By its own qualities it would not cause death, but whichever of the two is strong; with the ascendant and navamsa lord's aspect, death arises by yoga and aspect.
The measure of the risen division, doubled when it looks at itself, tripled with benefic aspect; the rest should be reasoned by one's own judgment.
Death by fire, water, ashes, wetness, drying, serpents is to be reckoned from the point, as stated — the cause of death for the man.
Jupiter, Moon, Venus, Sun, Mars, Saturn: placed in the eighth, they cause death in accordance with the gods, ancestors, and hells.
Strength of the Sun and Moon... the lord is best, middle or lowest; exalted... six, eight, or the aspect...
With Jupiter in the seventh, or in the enemy's or centre positions, destruction; with exaltation in the ascendant and twelfth and benefic parts, liberation, by strength from elsewhere.
At conception, birth; in knowledge, one should say 'tree-state' from the ascendant. By the former and latter halves of the ascendant, with benefics, one should tell the birth of another.
In the ascendant trine, by the thirds of wisdom and Jupiter, the parts are divided equally. With the Sun in summer in the rising..., from the Sun's house...
The Moon, Mercury and Jupiter... differently with Venus, Mars and Saturn. By the first aspects the month and the tithi arise by proportion.
Birth in reverse order by parts; the time is in the sign called 'night-day'; the ascendant of the best trine of the month, or in the obtaining and non-obtaining...
As much as the Moon is less than the ascendant, so much in the birth-star from the Moon. In Leo, the twins' lunar sign, Aries and Libra, Capricorn...
In the realm of ten, eight, seven, the remainders are multiplied by zero; Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury... (periods of planets).
For the stars the rule is constant, by the planets' power; the group of days multiplied by seven and divided by the stars gives the remainder star; nine, positive and negative.
Doubled gives the six seasons and months; by an elephant (8), the fortnight and tithi; multiplied by seven, the nights' stars; the hour called by the arrow-division of the limbs.
(Descriptions of the forms of the zodiac signs in the 36 parts:) A man bearing an axe, dark, red-eyed, able to protect; ...
tawny, blind, cruel, red-clothed, with wounds; hungry and thirsty, wearing milk-stained cloth, with cropped curly hair;
dirty, with a hungry, wasted face, skilful in farming and the like; with a body of two parts, afraid of the fabulous creature, a thin neck, anxious within;
a pure-seeming, chaste woman without offspring, with a raised hand; in a garden, a man in armour with a bow; sporting, with the face of Garuda;
knowing dance and the like, like Varuna, with many jewels and a bow; with elephant-face and throat, a boar-face, a forest-lord...
In the forest, on the branch of a palasha tree he cries; the head hard as a snake's; with a long face, covered, riding in a boat for money, going on water;
a man with a dog holds a jackal or vulture, and cries in a silk-cotton tree; a bow-carrier in black antelope skin, a lion; a horse raised, afflicted;
a destroyer of fruit and flesh, in a pot, with a bear's face, acting like a monkey; a girl with a basket of flowers and a plait; a woman in a dirty dress;
an archer, spendthrift and wounded, dark; a scribe, a man in a Rama-white; in a temple of gods, a woman washed with white cloth, a pot-sight...
a measurer and weigher, a sinful... in a shop, a man thinking of vessels, afflicted by hunger and thirst; a man with a pot, a woman and a son of the vulture...
an archer with strange behaviour; in snow armour following deer; a woman going to the sea bank with various serpents;
longing for comfort, turned limbs, a tortoise-shaped body; with a tortoise face, a lion in the Malaya hills, fearful of dog, jackal and deer;
one in a sitting posture with a dog's body, an archer, an ascetic at a sacrifice; a Champaka-like woman in the middle, a river increasing...
one in tortoise posture, Champaka-like, a staff-bearer, a silk-wearing woman; the supreme one, with a vulture's face, longing for oil and wine;
one at a burnt place, bearing iron, a woman with ornaments; a vessel-bearer, with hairy dark body, crowned, bearing a fruit-press;
one in a boat, adorned with many gems in hands; one reaching the shore in a boat with a herd, with a face like Champaka;
a naked man in a pit, wrapped in serpents, weeping, afflicted by thieves and fire. Such are the thirty-six parts of the signs, declared in order.
Thus the science of births has been told in brief, O best of sages. Now hear the Samhita section, useful for worldly affairs.
With the desired Jupiter, Sun, Moon and others, five strong planets, or four endowed with strength of position and joined with benefics,
free of the twenty-one great faults, without aspects (of malefics): all signs are best when joined with or aspected by benefics.
Signs in auspicious navamsas are to be accepted as auspicious signs; never one in Cancer's division, even when aspected by or joined with benefics.
Therefore the divisions of Taurus and Gemini, Libra and Virgo, are auspicious. The vow (initiation) is declared when the ascendant navamsa is such.
With malefics in the third, sixth and eleventh, and without the sixth, eighth and twelfth; benefics, and the Moon not in the sixth, eighth, ascendant or twelfth —
even the Moon in exaltation, if in the ascendant at the vow-taker's initiation, does not make the child poor and a consumptive in every way.
With the Sun shining in a central house, death of the father of the initiate; a lagna free of five faults is auspicious for the sacred thread ceremony.
Without the spring season, in the dark fortnight, at the Galagraha, on study-forbidden days, and on Vishti and the sixth (tithi): the rite is not allowed.
The four days beginning with the thirteenth, the three beginning with the seventh, or the fourth — these eight are called Galagrahas, said to be bad.
I shall tell of the razor-tying (kshurika) for kings, before marriage; in the months declared for marriage, in the bright fortnight when no planet is combust,
with Jupiter, Venus and Mars strong, with strength of Moon and star; on the tithis declared for the thread ceremony, on a day other than Mars's.
Not in the navamsa of the doer, without the eighth ascendant; with the eighth pure, the Moon, and an ascendant without sixth, eighth and twelfth;
with benefics in the second, trine and centre, and others in the third, eleventh and sixth, razor-tying is to be done after worshipping the gods and ancestors.
He should worship the razor well in the presence of the gods. Then at a good ascendant he should tie the marked one to the waist.
He should cut it to half the length of the end's breadth; the cut pieces are the fruit: a standard brings destruction of enemies;
a smoke-sign, death; a lion, victory; a dog, disease; a bull, great wealth; a donkey, becoming very unhappy;
an elephant, great joy; a crow, loss of wealth. The measure of the sword-and-doll (cuts) is counted by one's own finger.
In the measure-fingers one should drop a cycle of eleven; the fruits of the remaining finger-counts are as follows in order:
gain of a son, killing of an enemy, gain of a wife, good journey, loss of wealth, increase of wealth, love, success, victory, praise.
If it stands on the banner or bull and is lost, a wound from the front; on the lion or elephant in the middle, on the dog or crow at the end;
on the smoke or donkey, no wound... at the end part. Then in the northern course, with Venus and Jupiter visible,
for the twice-born, self-controlled, returning from the teacher's house; under the stars Chitra, Uttara (three), Punarvasu, Pushya, Anuradha, Rohini...
in the stars, on the days of Sun, Moon, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and in the ascendant divisions;

avoiding the first, parvan and empty tithis and the eighth for three days, the return home and tonsure are to be done on other days. The householder's stage is the best of all stages, O best of Brahmins.
Happiness there with a virtuous wife depends on the good ascendant; her virtue and play depend on the good ascendant.
Having considered the teaching of Pitamaha (Brahma), I shall tell the purity of the ascendant. On an auspicious day, one seated comfortably with a calm mind, endowed with marks,
bowing, he should ask the astrologer as a god, with devotion, approaching with a full handful of betel, fruit, flowers and the like.
If a cruel planet is in the ascendant and Mars in the seventh, the death of the couple should be said to occur before eight years.
If the Moon is in the ascendant and Mars in the seventh, the wise know the husband's death within eight years.
A malefic in the fifth from the ascendant, aspected by an enemy or debilitated: a dead son or a daughter, or a harlot, without doubt.
The Moon in the third, fifth, seventh, eleventh or tenth from the ascendant, aspected by Jupiter, makes a bond for the couple.
With Libra, Taurus and Cancer in the ascendant, joined with Venus and Moon and aspected, for those who ask there will be gain of a girl.
With a female decan, female navamsa, and an even-sign ascendant aspected by Moon and Venus, there will be gain of a girl.
So for women a husband is gained with a male ascendant and male navamsa; for the questioner the ascendant aspected by male planets.
In the dark fortnight, when the sign of the question-ascendant is aspected by a malefic or in the eighth, there will be no connection.
With auspicious omens and signs at the time of the question, good fortune; with these inauspicious ones the couple's misfortune everywhere.
On a day pure in the five limbs, with strength of Moon and star, or at the rising of a marriage-star, the choosing of the bride with relatives,
with ornaments, flowers, betel, fruits, perfumes, rice-grains, white garments, songs and instruments, with removal of obstacles and blessings,
the bridegroom should have it done in the maiden's house, preceded by Om. Then her father should make the gift with affection,
to the groom endowed with family, character, age, beauty, wealth and learning, he should give a beautiful young maiden.
Having worshipped and prayed to the goddess Shachi, abode of qualities, beauty of the three worlds, covered with divine perfumes, garlands and clothes,
endowed with all marks, adorned with all ornaments, lighting all directions with priceless garlands of gems,
attended day and night by thousands of charming women — thus, at the end of worship, one should pray to such a maiden:
Homage to you, Indrani, beloved of the lord of the gods; in marriage give me good fortune, health and gain of sons.
In an even year from birth for women, the clasping of the hand brings joy; for men in an odd year; in the reverse the opposite for the two.
The months Magha, Phalguna, Vaishakha and Jyeshtha give good; Kartika and Margashirsha are middling; the others are condemned.
Never when the Sun has entered Ardra under subjugated stars; marriage, installation of gods and the thread ceremony are not (done).
Not when Venus or Jupiter is combust, nor when they are young or old; not when Jupiter is in Leo or in the Leo division.
Venus risen in the east or west is a child for ten or thirteen days; Mercury for five days; Jupiter for a fortnight; in all cases.
As long as Hrishikesha is not awake, there is no auspicious rite; on the festival day of Vasudeva no other auspicious rite.
Not in the birth month, birth star, or birth day; the taking of the hand of the first-born child, son or daughter;
nor marriage between the eldest son and eldest daughter; in the month of Jyeshtha, of the two, one eldest is best, not otherwise.
After an omen or eclipse, seven days with a total eclipse; for less than total, three days is not approved; touching three days and the waning...
Eclipsed at setting, three days before; or after, at an eclipsed rising; at twilight three days likewise; at midnight, seven.
At the month's end he should avoid five days, the empty tithis, the eighth, Vyatipata, Vaidhriti, the whole Parigha (half?).
Under Revati, Uttara (three), Anuradha, Mrigashira, Mrigashira..., Pushya, Magha — with those without malefic piercing, the taking of a woman's hand is desired.
In marriage the strength of Jupiter and the Sun is necessary for the couple; if weak, worship of the two planets must be done carefully.
Transit, the blocking (vedha) strength, the ashtakavarga strength, and the strength of form: each later is greater; transit is the rough route.
Having seen the strength of Moon and star, then the strength of the five limbs: the tithi one-fold, the weekday two-fold, the star three-fold,
the yoga four-fold, the half-tithi (karana) five-fold. Then the mind and the muhurta are strong; then the ascendant is stronger.
Then the hora is strong, then the decan, then the navamsa, then the dvadashamsa is strong.
Then the trimshamsa is strong. Thus this strength and weakness should be seen. All signs joined with or aspected by benefics are praised for marriage.
The Moon, Sun, Jupiter and the others, five planets in the sign are desired; that ascendant is auspicious even if only four are strong.
Free of the twenty-one great faults and with seventh-house purity — I shall now briefly tell the names, forms and effects of the twenty-one faults. Listen, Narada.
The lack of purity in the five limbs is called the first fault; the lack of purity of rising and setting is the second; the Sun's transit is the third.
The malefic sixfold group, Venus the sixth, Mars the eighth (faults):
Gandanta, Kartari, a planet in the sixth, eighth or twelfth or in the Moon's house, the eighth ascendant of the couple, the sign, and the poison-ghati.
A bad muhurta, the weekday fault, Kharjurika, the Samanghri star, eclipse and omen stars, a star pierced by cruel planets or joined with them,
a bad navamsa, Mahapata, Vaidhriti — twenty-one. The combination of tithi, weekday, star, yoga and karana
is the purity of the five limbs, declared. In any ascendant where there is a fault of the five limbs, it is fruitless.
He should reject the five-fold, like milk mixed with poison. If the ascendant and its division are each aspected or joined by their own lord;
or if not, by the other's lord or a benefic friend — otherwise the groom's death from them; seventh and rising divisions.
Thus if the two are not joined or aspected, the bride's death at the taking of hands. Before and after the Sun's transit are to be avoided.
In marriage and other rites, sixteen nadis each; the six-fold division is best and auspicious for marriage, installation and the like.
The fault named Bhrigu-shashtha: Venus in the sixth from the ascendant. If exalted and joined with benefics, that ascendant should always be avoided.
Mars in the eighth is a great fault, with Mars in the eighth from the ascendant. The ascendant joined with three benefics should not be abandoned if Mars is exalted.
When the junction of the tithis Purna and Nanda is two nadis: the Ganda-anta causes death in birth, journey, marriage, vows and the like.
Between Cancer and Leo, Scorpio and Sagittarius, Pisces and Aries, the Gandanta interval is half a ghatika, giving death.
Ashlesha, Magha, Revati: the last sixteenth parts are the lords of star-junctions; and the first quarters of the following stars are called Gandanta.
The fierce junction-triad is the great Gandanta, threefold. With malefic planets facing the ascendant, straight or retrograde,
that is known as Kartari, a neck-cutter for the couple. An ascendant spoiled by the Kartari yoga should be avoided,
even if joined with benefic planets and endowed with all qualities. With the Moon in the sixth, eighth or twelfth, the ascendant fault called Chandra arises.
That ascendant should be avoided with effort, even if joined with Jupiter and Venus, whether exalted, debilitated, in a friend's sign or an enemy's.
Even if endowed with all qualities, it brings death to the couple. With the Moon joined with a planet, the fault called Samgraha arises.
